data.desc: Realty Income (NYSE: O), an S&P 500 company, is real estate partner to the world's leading companies. Founded in 1969, we serve our clients as a full-service real estate capital provider. As of September 30, 2026, we have a portfolio of over 15,500 properties in all 50 U.S. states, the United Kingdom ('U.K.'), and eight other countries in Europe. We are known as 'The Monthly Dividend Company' and have a mission to invest in people and places to deliver dependable monthly dividends that increase over time. Since our founding, we have declared 676 consecutive monthly dividends and are a member of the S&P 500 Dividend Aristocrats index for having increased our dividend for over 32 consecutive years. Additional information about the company can be found at www.realtyincome.com . Investors and others should note that we announce material financial and operational information to our investors using our investor relations website ( www.realtyincome.
